category_edits.rationale: Reduce maximum causal history length to max(1, ceil(0.75 × L)) across all four datasets to reduce stale context and recurrent computation. Existing truncation retains recent interactions in chronological order, and saved maxlen metadata applies the same limit in prediction. All other modeling and training settings remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Reduce default history length from 128 to 96 for training, validation, and generated prediction through existing maxlen metadata.
